name: atlas-creative-production
description: Concepts, scripts, visual design, animation, video editing and sound.

interface.longDescription: Develop ideas, scripts and storyboards; design interfaces and visuals; create video, motion graphics and 3D; direct voice, music and sound; edit captions; and verify exports with production workflows for Remotion, HyperFrames, Hypit, Lemo-Opuscar and OpenMontage. This curated collection combines community-developed skills from popular GitHub projects and selected specialist repositories. It is not an official product or endorsement of the original maintainers. Upstream licenses apply; some workflows require local runtimes, configured accounts, API keys or paid services.
interface.defaultPrompt: Help me design an interface, produce a video, or turn an image into editable 3D.
